title: Q-SYS-VECTOR-KB: SYS-4: vector index of the repository's own knowledge for the agents
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** file:foundation/kb_vector.py
**Status:** closed

Owner directive 2026-11-12: a system is an integrated collection of parts, not one worker and a database.

foundation/kb.py retrieves by keyword. Add a Cloudflare Vectorize index (ultrastable-kb) built from docs, doctrine, the queue and decisions, an embed step in the tick, and a retrieval path that kb.retrieve uses when the binding exists and falls back to keywords otherwise. Topology (Q-SYS-TOPOLOGY) declares the index.
Paths: foundation/kb_vector.py, foundation/kb.py, tests/foundation/test_kb_vector.py.
Acceptance: tests cover both paths; the index id is in doctrine/topology.json.

size: L

**Closing probe:** file:foundation/kb_vector.py exists and its tests pass.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 219.8 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
